content.text:
Square-format epic dark-fantasy digital painting, viewed from a low frontal angle. Five armored adventurers stand on jagged black volcanic rocks amid fire, smoke, sparks, and storm clouds. In the extreme foreground, the enormous ridged head and sweeping horns of a black demonic dragon rise toward the heroes; its glossy obsidian scales are split by glowing red-orange lava-like fissures, with many sharp spikes and curved horns framing the bottom and sides.

At center, a heavily armored knight in ornate black-and-gold plate stands in a wide battle stance. The knight wears a fully enclosed angular helmet with narrow glowing violet eye slits and a flowing royal-blue cape patterned with subtle gold ornament. They grip an oversized luminous purple energy sword diagonally upward toward the upper right, surrounded by violet sparks and mist.

Behind and above the knight, a dark-haired, bearded male mage in elaborate teal-and-gold robes raises both arms. His left hand holds a staff crowned by an intensely glowing cyan orb encircled by concentric magical rings and geometric sigils; orange fire swirls above his open right palm. At upper left, a dark-skinned male warrior with short curly black hair and a green cloak lunges forward, extending a long silver sword horizontally to the left. At lower left, a pale red-haired female spellcaster in dark metallic armor holds a blue-crystal staff while standing inside a translucent spherical blue magical shield filled with icy cracks, ripples, and glowing particles. At right, a pale white-haired female rogue crouches on the rocks in fitted black armor, holding a short sword low in one hand and raising a double-headed axe overhead with the other.

A gigantic silver-white dragon fills the upper-left background, its serpentine body winding behind the party. Its horned, spiny head thrusts forward with glowing blue eyes and a wide-open mouth full of needle-like teeth. A huge leathery brown-gray wing arches across the upper right. Several smaller winged dragons fly through the smoky distance around craggy mountains. The right background glows with orange fire and embers, while the left is dominated by cold blue magic. Highly detailed, cinematic, hyper-realistic fantasy concept art with intricate armor engraving, dramatic rim lighting, strong blue-purple-orange contrast, dense textures, and no visible text.
